subject.title: Dashboard: full-bleed tab layout + "tab app" bundle

question: Should full-bleed tab-app layout be accepted as a bundled dashboard capability after the Wave 1 modular dashboard stack lands, or should tab-app bundles stay external to plugin or ClawHub distribution?
rationale: This is a new user-facing dashboard mode with security-sensitive custom-widget behavior, and current main lacks the prerequisite dashboard substrate.

options.title: Keep As Wave 2 Item
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical app-layer follow-up and review it after the Wave 1 dashboard substrate is settled.

options.title: Route Bundle Distribution Out
options.body: Allow the layout seam but require individual tab-app bundles to ship through external plugins or ClawHub rather than bundled core.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap Only
options.body: Close this narrow item into the tracker if maintainers want the broader roadmap to own all Wave 2 dashboard planning.

recommendation.title: Keep As Wave 2 Item
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical app-layer follow-up and review it after the Wave 1 dashboard substrate is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest current-main owner for the plugin-tab seam that this feature would extend.
